summary: Iter3 testing of MS Park intranet. Backend 8/9 pass (1 fail: schedule pauses are computed dynamically (mid-22min) instead of the spec's fixed values). Frontend: login, protected route, header profile dropdown/logout, dashboard 'Prise de poste du jour' card, date-first agenda cards, planning banner removal, agenda 'Aucune inscription requise', restaurant cart drawer (store-locked, anticipez, heure trop tôt), and messagerie group creation modal all verified. Found and FIXED a critical blank-page bug in Messagerie (missing 'Users' import from lucide-react). Found another issue: Profil page still renders a 'Se déconnecter' button in the hero — spec said it should be removed.

critical.issue: Pauses are computed dynamically as (mid_shift - 22min, + 45min) instead of the spec's FIXED values. For start='14:00' got pause 16:08-16:53 (expected 16:30/17:15); for start='12:00' got 14:08-14:53 (expected 15:00/15:45); for start='15:00' got 17:08-17:53 (expected 17:00/17:45). Bug is at backend/server.py lines 402-411 — replace the mid-based calculation with a fixed lookup keyed on start time.

ui_bugs.issue: Hero still renders a 'Se déconnecter' button (Profil.jsx lines 70-76). Spec requires it removed (logout now lives only in the header avatar dropdown). Also: that button only navigate()s to /login WITHOUT setting localStorage 'ms_logged_out'='1', so it does not actually log out.

FIXED BY TESTER — Page rendered completely blank with React error 'Users is not defined'. Root cause: Messagerie.jsx used <Users /> on line 109 and line 389 but never imported it. Added 'Users' to the lucide-react import on line 3.

issues: Date/Heure de retrait use the browser's native <input type='date|time'> instead of the shadcn Calendar / Popover components used elsewhere — inconsistent UX (see system prompt design rule).
Pause times shown are 14:08/14:53, 16:08/16:53, 17:08/17:53 — visually confirms the backend schedule pause bug above. Users will see odd minute values until backend is fixed.

action_items: Frontend: remove the hero 'Se déconnecter' button from Profil.jsx (lines 70-76). If kept anywhere, it must localStorage.setItem('ms_logged_out','1') before navigate('/login').
Frontend: verify the Users-import fix landed (committed by tester). Optionally run a build/lint pass to catch other missing imports.
critical_code_review_comments: Messagerie.jsx had a runtime ReferenceError that bricked the entire page — no automated check caught it. Add an eslint `react/jsx-no-undef` or `no-undef` rule in CI to prevent regressions.

Profil 'Se déconnecter' button calls navigate('/login') without flipping ms_logged_out — anyone landing on /dashboard right after would be redirected back in by ProtectedShell only if ms_logged_out is set. This is a logout-without-logout footgun even if the button is intentionally kept.
Schedule generation uses arithmetic that does not match the explicit spec. Prefer a small fixed map / constant table — easier to read and audit.
server.py is still ~1575 lines in a single file. Splitting into routers (schedule, channels, orders, badge) would make spec compliance reviews cheaper.

success_rate.frontend: 85% (login, protected route, header dropdown, dashboard, agenda, planning-banner, restaurant cart all OK; profil hero logout bug; messagerie was 0% then 100% after import fix)

Frontend routes are /dashboard, /rh/planning (NOT /planning), /rh/badgeage, /rh/demandes, /profil, /restaurant, /messagerie, /agenda — see App.js. After login click, key is removed; after header-avatar logout, key is set to '1'.
rca_of_the_issue: Schedule pause RCA: server.py generates pauses with `mid = (start_m + end_m) // 2; pause_start_m = mid - 22; pause_end_m = pause_start_m + 45`. For a 12:00→17:00 shift this gives 14:08-14:53 instead of the spec's 15:00-15:45; for 14:00→19:00 gives 16:08-16:53 instead of 16:30-17:15; for 15:00→20:00 gives 17:08-17:53 instead of 17:00-17:45. Mitigation: replace with `FIXED = {'14:00': ('16:30','17:15'), '12:00': ('15:00','15:45'), '15:00': ('17:00','17:45'), '14:00_sun': ...}` keyed on (start,end) or just start, and look up ps/pe. Messagerie RCA: missing import — added Users to the lucide-react named-imports list at line 3. Profil logout-button RCA: the hero block (lines 56-77) was not deleted in this iteration's Profil.jsx rewrite — visual regression.
